C-GATE-SURFACE.IntentSummary:
Create the third check surface: invocable gates that declare required evidence, record decisions and review verdicts in run-ledger.xml outside Epoch-N (A30), and refuse approve/apply/archive (and further attempts on escalated tasks) without re-deriving what status and the cursor already know.
Authored before production code, per A17.3. A29 is normative over §5.3–§5.5; A30 is normative over A29 where they disagree — especially the recording home (correction 61). Build order is dependency, not style: ledger sections validate before anything records into them.

T-001.Title: Ledger Verdicts and Decisions sections with validator

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: run-ledger.xml admits optional Verdicts and Decisions sections under the C-* wrapper, siblings to Epoch-N. validateRunLedgerArtifact validates them (invariant 4). Write path is write, re-read, verify; Epoch-N append stays fold-only. Existing ledgers without the sections keep validating (invariant 5). Recording leaves run/ untouched (A30.1, A30.2). KNOWN_KIND_STATE is not widened (A30.4).

T-002.Title: Gate surface core, catalog, and requirement evaluation

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: src/gates/core.ts and catalog.ts exist. gate.* codes live only in the gates catalog. Required evidence absent fails closed; optional absent is reported; present is consulted. Blocking is a property of the gate (anti-pattern 9, D5).

T-003.Title: ngrace gate CLI and grace.ts registration

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Ninth subcommand ngrace gate approve|apply|archive --change C-X evaluates and records into Decisions; never authors status and never moves a bundle directory (A29.2, A29.13, invariant 8). Report is machine-actionable without prose parse.

T-004.Title: D14 boundary test — lint never emits gate.*

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: src/lint/core.test.ts (or equivalent integration) runs ngrace lint over a project with open epoch and absent review verdict and asserts zero gate.* codes. Both directions: gate evaluation still emits gate.* on its own surface (A29.7, D14).

T-005.Title: Typed Clarification grammar, validator, and templates

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Clarifications/Clarification with target= under change-spec and change-plan; invalid targets error; unresolved on IC-* or INV-* refuse approve. Prose markers are not a detection path (anti-pattern 3). Templates updated (A29.4, conclusion 3).

.ngrace-lint.json accepts gateFailOn; SUPPORTED_KEYS updated; unknown keys still error. Apply consults the project value for missing-verdict severity. A per-invocation flag alone does not satisfy AC-PROJECT-GATE-FAIL-ON (A29.5, conclusion 4).

T-007.Title: Three gate declarations and escalated-task attempt refusal

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: approve: clarification on IC/INV refuses; ASSUMPTION does not; non-satisfied AC does not block. apply: refuse no plan (consume needs-plan inputs), refuse no verdict, permit unable-to-determine, host-capability-missing under permissive vs strict gateFailOn. archive: refuse open epoch (listLooseEvents); permit after fold; recorded decisions and verdicts never read as open epoch (A30.1 deadlock both directions). cursor attempt on escalatedTasks refuses via gate evaluation (anti-pattern 9).

T-008.Title: Skill text, templates note, and packaged mirrors

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: ngrace-execute places gate apply/archive before rules 8–9; ngrace-plan places gate approve before approving; ngrace-spec/plan templates carry Clarification; ngrace-reviewer notes verdict record shape in Verdicts section; verdicts.md documents host-capability-missing. Packaged mirrors byte-identical; validate:marketplace green; line delta reported (A29.8).
